Use case: stylized-concept. Production GROUND MATERIAL ATLAS for Magic Mail, saturated hand-painted cartoon mobile game. ONE opaque square image divided into exactly TWO columns and TWO rows with four seamless texture quadrants, NO gutters, NO borders. Completely flat orthographic top-down material swatches, NOT a perspective landscape. Top LEFT: snowy volcanic side terrain, indigo-purple basalt earth with broad irregular ivory-blue snow banks covering 70 percent, a few warm plum exposed patches and tiny orange mineral grains. Top RIGHT: snowy volcanic walking path, warm pale peach sandstone exposed in a few natural elongated patches with thick soft cream-white snow over 75 percent, subtle blue shaded rims around snow patches. Bottom LEFT: snowy garden side ground, rich emerald earth with broad irregular white-blue snow banks over 70 percent and a few green exposed patches, very sparse tiny grass blades. Bottom RIGHT: snowy garden walking path, pale icy blue snow over 80 percent with a few warm cream sand patches and delicate soft shaded snow edges. Each quadrant is a repeatable texture, edges wrap smoothly; natural irregular organic distribution at large scale, broad simple painted gradients, subtle snowy grain and brushed color variation, richly illustrated but readable. NO objects, trees, rocks, icons, letters, tracks, grid lines, horizon, shadows from objects, text or UI. This texture will cover an existing curved 3D mesh, so do not paint any road boundaries, bevels or perspective.
